exact_control.description: Control: exact match when canonical session key is supplied

conclusions: On real conversational memory benchmark LongMemEval (100 questions, 265 session pool), bge-small achieves Recall@1=50.0%, Recall@5=87.0% (raw) and Recall@1=52.0%, Recall@5=85.0% (instructed).
Exact-key retrieval achieves 0/100 on natural language queries without canonical keys, but 100/100 when canonical keys are provided.
Session-level chunks in LongMemEval are significantly longer (mean ~2425.23 tokens), making RAG k=5 paste cost ~12140.9 tokens, drastically higher than exact-key get (45 tokens).
